method.call: phonemize(word, voice) from the phonemizer package, one word at a time. voice is en-us for us and en for uk, the same value Text to Speech passes for British voices.
method.us.unknown, us.strange, us.fantasy: Word lowercased. Output spaces removed, then these replacements in order: ʲ>j, r>ɹ, x>k, ɬ>l, ɚ>əɹ, ɜː>ɜɹ, ː removed, eɪ>A, aɪ>I, oʊ>O, aʊ>W, ɔɪ>Y, dʒ>ʤ, tʃ>ʧ, ɐ>ə, ʔ removed.
method.us.known: Word keeps its case from the set. Output is scored as it comes, with parts joined by a space.
method.uk: Word keeps its case from the set. Output spaces removed, then ʲ>j, r>ɹ, x>k, ɬ>l.
method.scoring: scoreCli.mjs --predictions over these strings. The strings are not stored.
